elements.note: A hand-drawn bunch of bananas: the thing that moves (the imported goods).
A curved hand-drawn arrow that draws itself on from the bananas down to the island: shows the movement.
The analogy world as one funny drawing: a banana-shaped island with a palm tree and a gorilla. Could also be built from separate props (island, palm, gorilla).

note: A dry concept made into a silly, simple picture: the term on top, the drawing under it, an arrow showing what moves. White background and outlined cartoon art keep it readable at a glance.
